newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power offers for Wed little changed.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power offers for Wed little changed.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) made few changes to surplus power offers for Wednesday, the agency said Tuesday.
BPA continued to offer up to 300 megawatts of firm power dduring peak demand hours at $12.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $13.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
Wednesday firm off-peak prices were also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
BPA continued to offer up to 300 MW of next-day non-firm power during morning and evening peaks (hours ending 0800-1000 and 1800-2000 PST) at $16.00 for Northwest and $17.00 for COB.

Non-firm power prices for off-peak (0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST) were unchanged at $9.00 for all deliveries, while prices for shoulder hours (1100-1700 and 2100-2200) were separated at $9.00 for Northwest and $10.00 for COB.
BPA also offered displacement power during off-peak hours on Wednesday at $7.00 per MWh.
